productionReads.unmeteredEarlierReads: unknown; the measured total is an all-session lower bound
productionReads.definition: Neon HTTP response body bytes including JSON framing; not storage IO. API backend bytes are not inferred from HTTP response size.

doorReads.limitations: Response body bytes include Neon JSON framing. Hourly projections assume no changed doors and the five-minute standing admission interval; active changes add their own rows. The baseline aggregate reads sizes on the server and returns no unrelated door values.

existingCandidateFactCheck.note: Existing facts on the candidate meeting IDs, including candidates whose new value may remain held; subtracting all is a conservative lower bound on new facts.

definitions.meetings: Distinct local fact-store meetings with both live title and start facts, including source-labelled date-only sittings; not all normalized rows are verified facts.
definitions.governmentMatches: Unique registered government IDs within this state/platform. Directory matches include calendars whose public read failed; retained-calendar counts distinguish usable evidence.
definitions.requests: Actual physical public calls, charged to the catalogue that initiated the government job; calls made before identity resolution remain in UNLOCATED. Alternate platforms discovered during those calls do not receive duplicate request charges.
definitions.rate: Conservative new live sitting facts divided by the source acquisition cohort wall time, including its restart. This is measured yield normalized to one acquisition hour, not a sustained production benchmark or the held-evidence replay speed.
definitions.coverage: NOT_MEASURED means no result in this bounded check, never proof of no publisher or no meetings. All 50 states, DC and five territories remain in standing inventory work.
definitions.memory: Per-row acquisition peak is the shared four-job measurement process while that row was active. Local publication replay peak includes PGlite and is not a production worker reservation.
